Resolves #19986

Adds `enableCrossZoneDrag: true` to `Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.TabSortZone` and snapshots/flips it to `false` inside `Neo.dashboard.dock.plugin.Maximize#suppressDragSources` alongside `allowOverdrag`, `boundaryContainerId`, and `enableProxyToPopup` (restored via `resetPresentation` from the same snapshot). While a dock pane is maximized, in-strip tab drags keep their local `TabHeaderSortZone` reordering without engaging `DragCoordinator` or firing `dockCrossZoneDragMove`, `dockCrossZoneDrop`, `dockCrossZoneDragCancel`, or `releaseVoidsReorder` against the docked layout beneath the maximized plane.

Evidence: L4 (hosted `E2E (Brain-gated tier)` green at `975046247c`; local `WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` red on `dev` 1/2 at the maximized arm and green 2/2 at `975046247c`) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` (`expect(midDrag.affordances).toEqual([])`), `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockMaximizePlugin.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockMaximize.spec.mjs`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` (`console` reorders left in `heavy-tabs` while `maximizedNodeId === 'heavy-tabs'`, `.neo-dock-maximized`, and `restore` action `pressed === true` remain intact) and `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs` (`releaseVoidsReorder` skipped when `enableCrossZoneDrag === false`). |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` (`expect(midDrag.actions[0]).toBe('overflow')` and `expect(midDrag.actions.slice(-2)).toEqual(['restore', 'close'])`). |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` (`docked control: an in-strip drag still shows the tab-into preview and reorders in place`). |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs` (runs in the hosted `E2E (Brain-gated tier)` workflow; red on `dev` at the maximized arm and 2/2 green at `975046247c`). |

## Deltas from ticket
- Added `enableCrossZoneDrag: true` to `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/TabSortZone.mjs`, gating `dragCoordinator` (`onDragMove`, `onDragEnd`, `onDragCancel`), `releaseVoidsReorder`, and `dockCrossZoneDragMove` / `dockCrossZoneDrop` / `dockCrossZoneDragCancel`.
- `src/dashboard/dock/plugin/Maximize.mjs` (`suppressDragSources` / `resetPresentation`) snapshots `zone.enableCrossZoneDrag`, sets `enableCrossZoneDrag: false` on the maximized pane's strip `TabSortZone`, and restores it on un-maximize.

## Test Evidence
- `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL.spec.mjs`: red on `dev` (1 of 2 fails at `maximized in-strip drag shows no dock drop preview`), `2 passed` at `975046247c`.
- `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockMaximizePlugin.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockMaximize.spec.mjs`: all pass in CI and locally.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] None required — all unit, component, and E2E suites run in CI.
